name: [E-Cash] Ledger invariant violated
message: The ledger reconcile found an unbalanced journal, a negative wallet, or debits != credits. Money is wrong: stop transfers and inspect GET /api/system/reconcile. @your-oncall-handle

name: [E-Cash] Bank rail settlement p95 is high
message: p95 time from transfer creation to bank webhook settlement is above {{threshold}} ms (now {{value}} ms). Cash-in and cash-out are slow or the rail is injecting latency; check GET /api/sim/chaos. Percentiles need the metric's percentile aggregations enabled in Metrics Summary. @your-oncall-handle

name: [E-Cash] MPIN failures spiking
message: {{value}} wrong MPIN attempts in 5 minutes. This looks like credential guessing. Lockout after 3 attempts is working per account, so check for many accounts being hit. @your-oncall-handle

name: [E-Cash] Transfer failure rate above 10%
message: More than {{threshold}} of finished transfers failed in the last 10 minutes (now {{value}}). Group by type to see whether the bank rail, the biller, or the ledger is rejecting. @your-oncall-handle
